help.title: Help & feedback
help.subtitle: Answers to common questions, and a way to tell us what to fix.

matching.a: When you ask for help, we look for a nearby volunteer at your venue who speaks your language and has the training your needs call for, e.g. a wheelchair-trained volunteer who speaks Español.

volunteers.a: Finding your seat, gate, restroom or elevator, getting around the venue, and translating. They can’t give medical care.

emergency.a: Call 911, or tell the nearest venue staff member. VenU volunteers aren’t emergency responders.

languages.a: You can list any of 21 languages, including ASL. Add every language you speak in Edit profile so we can find more helpers for you.

privacy.a: Only the person helping you, and only while they help: your first name, photo, languages and the needs you chose to share. See Privacy & data for the rest.

report.q: How do I report a facility problem?
report.a: On the Venue tab, tap the facility (e.g. an elevator or restroom), then Add Your Own Report. Everyone who opens that facility sees it.

help.feedbackHint: Something confusing, broken or missing? Tell us.
help.thanksBody: We read every note and use it to make VenU better.
